title: Example: add a regression test for a confirmed defect
goal: Add a focused regression test that fails for the confirmed defect and passes after the minimal repair.
context: The planner has reproduced the defect and identified the owning module. Replace this example with a real approved issue before implementation.
forbidden_changes: Do not modify production behavior unless the task is explicitly expanded by the planner.
Do not alter Package.swift or module boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: The regression test reproduces the reported behavior before the fix and passes after the fix.
The diff contains only files covered by this contract.
The actual required CI checks are recorded separately from local test results.
recovery: Revert the single task commit if the regression or required architecture gates fail; preserve failure evidence.
